title: FBI Photo B21
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single redacted still image from a U.S. military system with an incorrect system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome image from a U.S. military system showing one or two small dark objects near a crosshair reticle.
incidents.explanation: The operator was unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: One to two small, dark, objects are visible just above and to the right of the center of the reticle.
